name: git-hub
author: John P. Giatropoulos
description: Granular GitHub widgets — repo list, issue list, PR list, and issue details.

widgets.name: GitHubRepoList
widgets.description: Search and browse GitHub repositories. Publishes repoSelected events.

widgets.name: GitHubIssueList
widgets.description: List GitHub issues for a repository. Listens for repoSelected, publishes issueSelected.

widgets.name: GitHubPRList
widgets.description: List pull requests for a repository. Listens for repoSelected, publishes prSelected.

widgets.name: GitHubIssueDetail
widgets.description: Display full details of a GitHub issue. Listens for issueSelected events.

widgets.name: GitHubWidget
widgets.description: Search repos and list issues via the GitHub MCP provider.
